description: GeoNetBC Geodetic Control Monuments - High Precision - Public Access is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Geodetic control monuments for BC from Geodetic Network British Columbia (GeoNetBC). Geodetic Control Monuments (GCMs) are a network of interconnected permanent markers in the ground which have accurately determined coordinates, and/or elevations. They are fixed points on which to spatially reference surveys, mapping, aerial and satellite imaging, etc. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are Canada, MASCOT, geodetic control, survey monument. It offers 4 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-07-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
